title: Hello Forge
hook: The forge engine's first room: a torch-lit crypt you walk in first person, drawn by the Rust core.
prompt: gf-forge wave 0 skeleton (research/rust-engine/PLAN.md §4, not a game for anyone yet): one room of glTF pieces, lit and fogged, a swappable texture slot and a model slot, first-person look and walk, through create and verify

round.winBy: Find the chest the crypt guards and walk up to it.
round.loseBy: The time runs out before you reach it.

rules.summary: Walk the torch-lit crypt in first person and reach the chest by the far wall before the time runs out.
rules.scoring: +1 for reaching the chest, which wins the round

content.notes: An empty stone room with a chest.

accept: the room reads as a lit, fogged crypt
mouse look and the WASD walk, with walls that stop you
the stone texture and the chest swap like any slot
notInV1: weapons, hits and feel (forge-feel, track F)
friends seen as bodies (skinning, track R; live co-op, track S)
